name: The Orville
description: Follow the crew of the not-so-functional exploratory ship in the Earth's interstellar fleet, 400 years in the future.

videos.title: The Orville Panel at PaleyFest 2018
videos.overview: The cast and crew of "The Orville" host a panel at PaleyFest 2018 where they have a Q&A and discuss the show, its future, and more.

videos.title: The First Six Missions
videos.overview: Get caught up on the first six adventures of The Orville and her crew. Originally released ahead of episode 7, this supercut was intended to quickly catch new viewers up-to-speed on the first half of Season 1.

videos.title: The Orville Inside Look
videos.overview: Go behind the scenes of "The Orville", featuring interviews with the cast and creative team behind the series.

videos.title: The Science of The Orville - Alien Life
videos.overview: More than a rubber mask, the aliens of "The Orville" are rooted in scientific principals about what life might look like beyond our solar system.

videos.title: The Science of The Orville - Quantum Drive
videos.overview: The speed of light is the greatest limiting factor of any science fiction series, The Orville overcomes that limit with something that is closer to fact than fiction.

videos.title: Crafting Aliens
videos.overview: Go behind the scenes with the makeup team responsible for turning human actors into otherworldly beings.

videos.title: Directed By...
videos.overview: Interview with the pilot's director Jon Favreau.

videos.title: The Orville Takes Flight
videos.overview: The Orville herself is an actual, physical model. Go behind the scenes to see how the crew of the show uses the model to make the show feel more real.

videos.title: A Better Tomorrow
videos.overview: Seth McFarlane explains why it is important that science fiction should be about a more optimistic future.

videos.title: Designing the Future
videos.overview: Seth McFarlane discusses the set and how the set reflects an aspirational future.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: It's 2417, and the Planetary Union promotes Ed Mercer to Captain of the exploratory vessel The U.S.S. Orville. Ed's enthusiasm for his new position is dampened when his ex-wife, Kelly Grayson, is assigned to be his First Officer. While on their first routine mission, the Orville crew is ambushed by the Krill, a vicious alien race, who are bent on stealing a device that can cause time to accelerate.

videos.title: Command Performance
videos.overview: When Ed and Kelly are tricked by a hologram of a ship in distress and find themselves prisoners in a replica of their former home, Alara must step up in her first command of the Orville and attempt a heroic rescue. Meanwhile, Bortus and Klyden receive some happy, yet unexpected news.

videos.title: About a Girl
videos.overview: The Orville crew is divided between cultures when Bortus and Klyden debate if their newly born offspring should receive a controversial surgery.

videos.title: If the Stars Should Appear
videos.overview: Ed and the Orville crew encounter a massive vessel adrift in space, which is in danger of colliding with a star. While some of the crew set out to help the ship's inhabitants, Bortus, Gordon, and John stay behind and fend off a Krill attack on another Union ship

videos.title: Pria
videos.overview: After the crew saves a stranded ship and its attractive captain, Ed becomes smitten with the Orville’s new guest, while Kelly suspects all is not what it seems. Meanwhile, Gordon attempts to teach Isaac the art of pulling off a practical joke.

videos.title: Krill
videos.overview: After the Orville crew defeats a Krill attack on a brand-new colony, the Union sends Ed and Gordon on a dangerous undercover mission to infiltrate a Krill ship and obtain a copy of the Krill bible, the "Anhkana," to better understand the enemy.

videos.title: Majority Rule
videos.overview: When two Union anthropologists go missing on a planet similar to 21st century Earth, Ed sends a team led by Kelly to find them, but the mission quickly goes awry when they realize the society’s government is completely based on a public voting system to determine punishment.

videos.title: Into the Fold
videos.overview: Ed and the crew set out to save Dr. Finn, her two sons and Isaac after their shuttle gets thrown into uncharted space and they crash-land on a moon that is light years from the Orville.

videos.title: Cupid's Dagger
videos.overview: The Orville is called to mediate a peace treaty between two warring cultures, but tensions run even higher between Ed and Kelly when a familiar face boards the ship. Meanwhile Yaphit declares his love for Dr. Finn with surprising results.

videos.title: Firestorm
videos.overview: When a fire breaks out on The Orville and a crew member dies, Alara begins to question if she is fit for her job, just as unusual and terrifying things start happening on the ship.

videos.title: New Dimensions
videos.overview: Kelly discovers that Lt. John Lamarr is smarter than he lets on. So, she pushes Ed to consider him for a key leadership position on the ship after The Orville gets damaged by a mysterious spatial anomaly causing harrowing effects to all things living.

videos.title: Mad Idolatry
videos.overview: Ed and Kelly consider the possibility of reforging their relationship, but Kelly soon crash-lands on a planet in another universe with Isaac and Gordon.

videos.title: Ja'loja
videos.overview: As The Orville heads towards Moclus for Bortus' special once-a-year ceremony, Ed discovers Kelly has moved on and has started dating. Meanwhile, Gordon asks for John's help in getting game, and Claire turns to Isaac for parenting advice.

videos.title: Primal Urges
videos.overview: Ed and the crew race to save a small group of survivors on a planet about to be destroyed by its sun. Meanwhile, Bortus and Klyden start marriage counseling when Bortus' obsession with the ship's simulation room gets out of hand.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: Ed, Gordon and Alara visit Alara's home planet of Xelayah.

videos.title: Nothing Left on Earth Excepting Fishes
videos.overview: Ed finds himself behind enemy lines when he crash-lands on a mysterious planet. Meanwhile, Kelly questions why Gordon wants to take the Command Test.

videos.title: All the World is Birthday Cake
videos.overview: The Orville makes First Contact and a new crew member joins the ship.

videos.title: A Happy Refrain
videos.overview: The Orville crew is surprised when Claire's personal life takes an unexpected turn, and Gordon makes an unusual grooming suggestion to Bortus.

videos.title: Deflectors
videos.overview: One of Bortus's old lovers is assigned to help upgrade the ships defences and makes a surprising admission to Talla.

videos.title: Identity (1)
videos.overview: Ed and the crew travel to Isaac's home planet, Kaylon.

videos.title: Identity (2)
videos.overview: The Kaylons take control of the Orville with the intention of destroying all biological lifeforms.

videos.title: Blood of Patriots
videos.overview: Ed must initiate peace talks with the Krill.

videos.title: Lasting Impressions
videos.overview: The Orville crew members open a time capsule from 2015.

videos.title: Sanctuary
videos.overview: Ed discovers that Moclans aboard The Orville are harboring a secret.

videos.title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
videos.overview: A time distortion affects Ed and Kelly's relationship.

videos.title: The Road Not Taken
videos.overview: The crew must contend with the disastrous fallout from Kelly's decision.

videos.title: Electric Sheep
videos.overview: The Orville crew deals with the interpersonal aftermath of the battle against the Kaylon.

videos.title: Shadow Realms
videos.overview: The Orville explores a mysterious region of space.

videos.title: Mortality Paradox
videos.overview: The Orville crew discovers signs of a modern civilization on a planet known to be uninhabited.

videos.title: Gently Falling Rain
videos.overview: The Orville crew leads a Union delegation to sign a peace treaty with the Krill.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Topas
videos.overview: Tensions between Kelly and the Moclans result when she helps Topa prepare for the Union Point entrance exam.

videos.title: Twice in a Lifetime
videos.overview: The crew must rescue Gordon from a distant yet familiar world.

videos.title: From Unknown Graves
videos.overview: The Orville discovers a Kaylon with a very special ability.

videos.title: Midnight Blue
videos.overview: The crew visit Haveena's sanctuary world and embark on a journey that may leave the Union more vulnerable.

videos.title: Domino
videos.overview: The creation of a powerful new weapon puts the Orville crew — and the entire Union — in a political and ethical quandary.

videos.title: Future Unknown
videos.overview: A celebration is underway aboard the ship.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 3 wins & 17 nominations total
